text: tabilet-skills 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的共享记忆技能与项目记录侧栏。插件注册技能文件提供方，并在右侧面板显示项目概览、任务、验收、记忆、阶段、历史、兼容性和 SQLite 视图。用户可以筛选和查看本地项目记录、检查技能来源，并预览 Next、Goal、Propose、Reconcile、Upgrade、Init 或 Archive 请求，再自行插入草稿或复制发送。可选 SQLite 页面以只读方式浏览审计运行、事件和 Markdown 索引。适合希望在 DSH 会话中查看项目记忆并准备规范工作流请求的开发者；安装插件本身不要求额外密钥。

tabilet-skills adds memory skills and a project sidebar to DSH web. Browse tasks, history, stages, skill sources, and optional read-only SQLite audit data. Review workflow requests before copying or inserting them into an empty draft. No API key is required.
想在 DSH 侧栏里查看当前项目的任务和里程碑
能不能在聊天时浏览项目记忆和阶段说明
我想检查项目有哪些验收记录和历史归档
帮我根据项目任务准备下一步工作请求，但让我先检查内容
I want a sidebar to browse project tasks and memory during a DSH session.
Can I inspect local audit runs and search the project Markdown index read-only?
tabilet-skills 的功能「项目记录侧栏」：面板按概览、任务、验收、记忆、阶段、历史和兼容性组织当前项目资料，可筛选任务并打开来源文件。
tabilet-skills 的功能「工作流请求预览」：用户选择 Next、Goal、Propose、Reconcile、Upgrade、Init 或 Archive 后填写所需信息，插件生成预览；用户可复制或插入空草稿。
tabilet-skills 的功能「SQLite 审计浏览」：可选视图以只读模式分页查看项目审计运行、事件与 Markdown 索引，也可按文本搜索索引条目。

tabilet-skills README · tabilet-skills：Seven shared engineering skills and a Memory Bank sidebar for DeepSeek Harness.
The same project Markdown remains usable from DSH, Codex, and Claude Code.
The canonical skills and project format live in
[tabilet/skills](https://github.com/tabilet/skills).

tabilet-skills README · tabilet-skills：Version **2.16.2** pins the canonical v2.16.2 skills, including extended milestone IDs, configurable review limits, required
amendments, deferred options, optional offline reflection, bundled goal protocols
and fingerprint registries, project addenda, user-selected model policy, and
approval email. The dashboard reads root and child milestone files and their
retired records; options require owner approval and do not block parent closure.
Goal previews select the bundled protocol without requiring a project-owned
`tabilet/GOAL.md`. Reflection stays off in previews and needs separately enabled
project auditing and the optional toolkit when explicitly requested. It retains
the read-only SQLite dashboard, Stages view and stage targeting for Propose.
It loads on the DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 launcher and
accepts the Zod 4.6.2 version resolved by the supported DSH rc.2 profile. See
[acceptance and publication status](https://github.com/tabilet/tabilet-skills/blob/main/docs/ACCEPTANCE.md)
for the separate GitHub, npm, and catalog release gates.

tabilet-skills README · tabilet-skills：The v2.16.2 stock protocol has the v2.16.0 fingerprint. Goals paused on older protocols require
approval of that identity transition before adopting it; installing this package
does not migrate project rules, approve grants or reset counters and limits.

tabilet-skills README · tabilet-skills：Each project can manually enable audit recording in its own database at
`tabilet/audit.sqlite3`. Registered linked worktrees share their repository's
database. Older shared storage is not selected by default; if you have one
(including from before v2.5.0), you can ask your LLM agent to extract this
project's history and import it into its SQLite database.

tabilet-skills README · Install：Supported target: Linux, Node **24.14.1**, DSH **0.1.5-rc.2**. The test installation
locks all components. An isolated rc.1 launcher with rc.2 components is also
checked; this is separate from the canonical repository's all-rc.1 suite.
Install DSH separately. This package ships prebuilt output, complete skill
resources, and no installation scripts or DSH runtime.

Install in each profile where you want the skills:

tabilet-skills README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/tabilet/tabilet-skills/releases/download/v2.16.2/tabilet-skills-2.16.2.tgz --ignore-scripts
dsh plugin --profile headless add https://github.com/tabilet/tabilet-skills/releases/download/v2.16.2/tabilet-skills-2.16.2.tgz --ignore-scripts
```

tabilet-skills README · Install：Restart the profile, open a project session, expand the native right sidebar,
and choose **Memory Bank**. The v2.16.2 headless package loads all seven skills,
including Propose, without the Web UI.
You can also replace the package/version with the absolute path to the prebuilt
archive from the [GitHub release](https://github.com/tabilet/tabilet-skills/releases/tag/v2.16.2).
Git source checkouts require the build step below to generate the complete payload.

tabilet-skills README · Install：For skills without the dashboard, use the canonical
[filesystem installation](https://github.com/tabilet/skills/blob/main/docs/DSH.md#install-the-seven-bundles).
Select the `v2.16.2` source tag when following that guide.
Both routes use complete canonical skill directories. Project and user overrides
retain DSH's normal precedence. The Compatibility view reports winning sources
and marks a bundled copy shadowed by an override. Other shadowed copies are not
enumerated by DSH's public registry. Review local overrides before removing them.

tabilet-skills README · Read project records：- **Overview:** active root milestones, required `amend-M01-01.md` and deferred
  `option-M01-02.md` children with their parents, all six marker counts, blocked
  rows, and work in progress. Child kinds share one permanent number sequence.
- **Tasks:** milestone, lane, and state filters, text search, full task notes,
  and source navigation.
- **Acceptance:** recorded verification/review lines and an explicit current
  review counter when the record supplies one. Unknown and conflicting evidence
  stay visible. Terminal rows do not prove acceptance.
- **Memory:** product, architecture, stack, and curated lessons.
- **Stages:** the optional current stage and preliminary later ideas from
  `tabilet/stages.md`. Without it, the project has one implicit stage. Stage
  descriptions do not create executable task rows.
- **History:** retired index, complete preserved records, knowledge history,
  and context archives. Historical bodies load only when opened.
- **Compatibility:** missing or malformed files, unsupported legacy state,
  duplicate identities, multiple in-progress rows, and skill sources.
- **SQLite:** read-only browsing of the selec

tabilet-skills README · Read project records：The v2 sidebar reads an unmigrated v1.5.0 project with a migration warning and
offers source navigation. Workflow request controls are hidden until the
project is explicitly migrated. The canonical Upgrade bundle includes
`migrate-v1.5-to-v2.py`, a read-only preview by default and an explicit
`--apply` mode. Installing this package never runs migration.

tabilet-skills README · Read project records：The panel follows the selected session. DSH observations, a five-second visible
refresh cycle, focus, and manual refresh detect changes. File versions control
the content cache. Interrupted or partial reads are labelled incomplete/stale.
Local canonical paths follow the host's existing permissions; denied paths are
reported. Some DSH configurations reject final symlinks or directory listings
outside the workspace. No permission changes or copied project memory are used.

tabilet-skills README · Read project records：Documents are displayed as literal text. Embedded HTML, images, and remote URLs
do not execute or load. Files larger than 2 MiB are reported as unsupported in
the dashboard; source navigation remains available. Viewing and refreshing make
no model requests and no project writes.

tabilet-skills README · Prepare a workflow request：Expand **Prepare a workflow request** and choose Next/Resume, Goal, Propose, Reconcile,
Upgrade, Init, or Archive. Every shortcut opens a preview. Goal requires an
explicit milestone order and completion conditions, defaults to `COMMIT_POLICY:
task`, offers `none`, and includes `EXTERNAL_MUTATIONS: none`.

tabilet-skills README · Prepare a workflow request：Propose requires one multiline requested-change field. It prepares a request
for inspection and one complete planning proposal before any writes, with
`EXTERNAL_MUTATIONS: none`. The preview preserves line breaks and never sends
itself. Its optional Stage focus accepts `--stages` for the overview or a stable
ID such as `STG-02` for one stage. A stage-only request does not schedule tasks
unless the user also asks to plan milestones.

tabilet-skills README · Prepare a workflow request：Reconcile accepts a local review path or a user-supplied URL as text. Preparation
does not fetch it; the skill still requires separate confirmation before any
remote review fetch. Init, Archive, Propose, Reconcile, and Upgrade retain their proposal
and write approval gates.

tabilet-skills README · Prepare a workflow request：**Insert into empty draft** succeeds only in the same session and unchanged,
empty plain-text draft without attachments or reference chips. Otherwise your
draft remains intact and the preview can be copied. You send the request normally.
The controls never submit, queue work, approve proposals, or edit task markers.
A marker does not establish exclusive ownership of the ledger.

tabilet-skills README · Prepare a workflow request：Existing compatible projects work directly. Updating this plugin does not
migrate project rules. Use the explicit Upgrade workflow when adopting a newer
contract; preserve permanent IDs, task history, and local policies.

tabilet-skills README · Update or remove：Install the selected exact version with the same profile-specific command and
restart DSH. To roll back, disable the `tabilet-skills` row in that profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`, or remove just this package:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove tabilet-skills
dsh plugin --profile headless remove tabilet-skills
```

tabilet-skills README · Update or remove：Project memory, unrelated plugins, and direct filesystem skill installs remain
available. A disabled bundle leaves its payload on disk but unregisters its
provider and UI; removal removes its profile bundle layer.

tabilet-skills README · Develop and verify：```bash
npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
npm install --global pnpm@11.22.0 --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
npm run verify

`upstream.lock.json` pins the canonical version, full commit, and every payload
hash. `npm run build` generates `payload/` from that commit, using a sibling
checkout when available or an isolated fetch of the exact commit. Never edit
generated skills. To deliberately advance to a reviewed canonical local commit:

tabilet-skills README · Develop and verify：```bash
node scripts/upstream.mjs pin ../skills HEAD
npm run verify
```

On a Linux distribution not recognized by Playwright, set `TABILET_CHROMIUM` to
a compatible Chromium executable for the Web tests. CI is credential-free. No paid workflow runs are part of this release's plugin
acceptance. [Contributor instructions](AGENTS.md) and
[acceptance evidence](docs/ACCEPTANCE.md) describe test boundaries and limitations.

tabilet-skills README · Publication and catalog：Track GitHub/npm publication, catalog submission, and listing separately.
[The catalog rules](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/blob/main/contributing.md)
require an installable bundle, working code, the `dsh-plugin` repository topic,
and a repository at least one day old. The submission is one YAML entry;
listing is confirmed only after acceptance and market visibility.

tabilet-skills README · Publication and catalog：The DSH catalog entry is updated through a separate reviewed submission. If a
new release is not yet listed, install its prebuilt archive from the GitHub
release above. npm publication is optional for this route.
